select gv.ver_id, gv.common_id, gc.common_name, gv.shop_id, gv.operate_user_id, gv.operate_user_name, gv.operate_time, gv.version_no from ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_version gv left join ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_common gc on gc.common_id = gv.common_id INNER JOIN ( SELECT common_id, MAX(operate_time) AS max_time FROM ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_version WHERE shop_id = #{param.shopId} GROUP BY common_id ) AS latest ON gv.common_id = latest.common_id AND gv.operate_time = latest.max_time where gv.shop_id = #{param.shopId}
and gc.common_name like concat('%',#{param.commonName},'%')
and gv.operate_user_name like concat('%',#{param.operateUserName},'%')
and (gv.operate_time between #{param.startTime} and #{param.endTime})
ORDER BY gv.operate_time DESC
